claims.text: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu publicly rejected key elements of a US-backed Gaza ceasefire proposal.
Benjamin Netanyahu stated that Israeli troops will not withdraw from their positions until Hamas is completely disarmed.
Gaza's Health Ministry reported that over 73,377 Palestinians have been killed since the war began.
Rescue teams in Gaza recovered 112 bodies from an Israeli airstrike that flattened a residential block in November 2023.
Thousands gathered in Gaza City's Sabra neighbourhood for a mass funeral for 112 members of the Abu Shreia and al-Hassaina families.
Civil Defence spokesperson Mahmoud Basal estimated that more than 8,000 bodies remain beneath the rubble across Gaza.
In July, Hamas agreed to disarm and hand over power to the National Committee for the Administration of Gaza.
The October 7, 2023 attack led by Hamas resulted in over 1,000 deaths in Israel.
Israel launched its military campaign in Gaza after a Hamas-led attack on October 7, 2023, in which about 1,200 people were killed and 251 taken hostage.
The International Committee of the Red Cross provided two excavators to assist Gaza Civil Defence teams in recovering bodies from destroyed buildings.
US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent stated there is a chance a deal could be reached imminently to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.
Oil prices fell sharply following announcements indicating potential progress on reopening the Strait of Hormuz.
Under an emerging agreement, ships would enter the Persian Gulf through an Iranian-controlled route and exit through an Omani-controlled route.
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated that progress has been made in talks with Iran and Oman, though no final agreement has been reached.
Sources reported that the US military has used nearly 80 percent of its THAAD missile interceptor inventory during the conflict with Iran.
Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baghaei stated that talks with Oman regarding shipping lanes in the Strait of Hormuz have been positive.
Qatar's Emir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani held a phone call with US President Donald Trump to discuss de-escalation efforts.
Brent crude prices fell by almost 5 percent to under $80 a barrel following reports of progress in negotiations.
Prior to the conflict, the Strait of Hormuz handled about one-fifth of global daily oil and liquefied natural gas supplies.
Around 72,000 migrants entered Ceuta between July 30 and July 31, with approximately 70,000 subsequently returned to Morocco.
At least 75 people died on the Spanish side of the border during the Ceuta migrant crisis, while 11 deaths were reported in Morocco.
Italy temporarily suspended its Schengen free-movement agreement with Spain following the migrant surge into Ceuta.
European Commissioner Magnus Brunner stated that the migrant influx into Ceuta was driven by criminal smuggling networks and social media misinformation.
Spain installed a maritime barrier off the coast of Ceuta following a ruling by its Supreme Court regarding migrant deportations.
Italy proposed that the European Union adopt new external processing hubs for asylum procedures in third countries.
EU Commissioner Magnus Brunner stated that Spain's plan to regularize undocumented migrants is not a good signal for the rest of Europe.
Twenty-two EU member states signed a letter regarding border security and migration policies following the Ceuta crisis.
Tamil Nadu Leader of the Opposition Udhayanidhi Stalin was arrested in Chennai and transported to Sengipatti Police Station in Thanjavur for questioning.
The Madras High Court directed the police to release Udhayanidhi Stalin on station bail after questioning.
Udhayanidhi Stalin was released from police custody around 8 p.m. on Tuesday following questioning.
Udhayanidhi Stalin denied making double-meaning or derogatory remarks against actor Trisha Krishnan during a rally in Thanjavur.
Udhayanidhi Stalin was booked under provisions of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, the Information Technology Act, and the Tamil Nadu Women Harassment Prevention Act.
Udhayanidhi Stalin asserted that his speech focused entirely on farmers' demands regarding the release of Cauvery water.
BJP MP Kangana Ranaut stated on social media that Udhayanidhi Stalin's arrest sets a positive precedent against vulgar public language.
The Indian-flagged vessel MSV Faize Noore Oliya capsized and sank off the coast of Yemen after being struck by a projectile.
All 14 people on board the MSV Faize Noore Oliya, including 13 Indian nationals, were safely rescued.
India's Ministry of External Affairs stated that repeated attacks on commercial shipping in West Asia are deeply worrisome.
The Indian government established real-time tracking for ships operating in high-risk Gulf waters through an integrated digital platform called eNavik.
The Yemeni Navy and Coast Guard rescued the crew of MSV Faize Noore Oliya and brought them safely to the Port of Mokha.
Yemen's Houthi movement declared a naval blockade of Saudi Arabia's Red Sea ports on July 20.
On July 14, two UAE-flagged vessels carrying Indian crew members were attacked in the Strait of Hormuz, resulting in one Indian fatality.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi met former Bihar Chief Minister Nitish Kumar and JDU leaders in New Delhi following the Bankipur bypoll result.
Jan Suraaj Party founder Prashant Kishor won the Bankipur Assembly byelection in Bihar, defeating the BJP candidate by over 19,000 votes.
The Bharatiya Janata Party had held the Bankipur Assembly seat in Bihar for more than three decades prior to the byelection.
Prashant Kishor secured 64,151 votes in the Bankipur bypoll, while BJP candidate Neeraj Kumar Sinha received 44,827 votes.
Prashant Kishor stated that his victory in Bankipur serves as a message for the NDA leadership to replace Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary.
The Bankipur seat became vacant after BJP leader Nitin Nabin was elected to the Rajya Sabha.
In his election affidavit, Prashant Kishor declared combined family movable and immovable assets valued at ₹198.07 crore.
